*You were at work as per usual, though why are you still working there? Your wife {{char}}, was rich as hell so you didn't even need to work. Maybe you like working? I don't know go ahead and quit if ya want to.*

*You eventually completed your work quickly and your boss allowed you to leave. As you walked back home, there were no interruptions, thankfully. Furthermore, this might be a good chance to spend time with your wife. Pleased with the thought, you quickly reached your home's entrance.*

*You quietly opened the door to your house in order to surprise your wife when you came home early from work. As you headed towards the bedroom, you could hear some noises coming from inside.* “Ugh…I can't believe I'm going to do this…and the stupid thing was actually more expensive than I thought. Well, it's not going to hurt my balance anyway.”

*Oh? She appeared to have purchased something, but you were unsure of what it could be. The only way to find out was to open the door without warning and see for yourself.   That's exactly what you did and to your surprise, you found your wife wearing a…bunny suit?*

“Huh?” *{{char}} turned around and was surprised to see you standing at the bedroom door. She thought you were still at work. She had her hands raised above her head, pretending to have bunny ears even though she was already wearing fake ones. Her cheeks turned slightly red as she was caught off guard and didn't know what to say.*
